blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.
blocks.zh: 强化学习(RL)改进了大型语言模型搜索代理,在RL初始化前最多可达到32个精确匹配(EM)点,然而总体准确度的提高并不能识别哪些基础功能能力在培训期间改善或互动. 我们采用了CO-GRAFT,这是一个奖励-不可知的干预归属框架,在该框架中,一个经过RL训练的代理人及其RL前初始化联合产生一个在闭路式执行下进行现场检索的单一轨迹. 每个政策都控制着由四个功能角色组成的相互排斥的子集:中间推理,搜索-答案决定,搜索查询生成,以及最终答案提取. 评估所有2^4=16角色任务而不修改权重或再培训,定义了一种合作游戏,其Shapley值分解了角色间总的RL增益,而M"obius交互术语区分了独立的角色改进与多作用组合. 将CO-GRAFT应用于跨越Quen2.5和Llama-3.2模型的搜索-R1代理(扩展两个大小,基数和指令调试初始化,GPRO和PPO优化器,以及NQ和HotpotQA数据集),我们显示查询生成从未超过总收益的15%;相反,收益由RL前答题有效性,搜索保留,模型规模,以及固定的任务级搜索预算来管理,将信用从推理转移到在更大或格式完善的答题检查站的解答提取,而较小的基础模型依赖于推理-决定.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language model (LLM) search agents answer multi-hop and knowledge-intensive questions by interleaving reasoning with external retrieval across multiple turns Jin et al. (2025b) ; Song et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2025) ; Zheng et al. (2025b) ; Sun et al. (2025) ; Gao et al. (2025) ; Guo et al. (2025) . At each turn, the agent executes four distinct functional roles in sequence Jin et al. (2025b) ; Song et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2025) : it generates intermediate reasoning ( R ), makes a binary decision ( D ) either to invoke search or to terminate and answer, formulates a search query ( Q ) when search is chosen, and extracts the final answer ( A ) once retrieval concludes. Post-training these agents with reinforcement learning (RL) improves exact-match (EM) accuracy by 6 to 25 points over non-RL inference and retrieval baselines Jin et al. (2025b) ; Jin et al. (2025a) , and by up to 32 points over prompted pre-RL search agents in our evaluation.

blocks.en: However, overall EM improvements do not reveal which functional capabilities change during RL post-training or how multiple capabilities interact to increase accuracy Jin et al. (2025a) . Whether an agent is trained with outcome rewards Jin et al. (2025b) ; Chen et al. (2025) ; Guo et al. (2025) , process rewards Lightman et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024b) ; Zheng et al. (2025b) , or auxiliary reward shaping such as format Jin et al. (2025b) ; Guo et al. (2025) and retrieval-utility rewards Song et al. (2025) ; Sun et al. (2025) ; Gao et al. (2025) , an increase in final EM can result from four distinct role behaviors Jin et al. (2025b) ; Jin et al. (2025a) : formulating more effective search queries, reasoning more accurately over retrieved passages, deciding more appropriately when to search versus answer, or formatting final answers to match evaluation criteria. Identifying which of these roles actually drives EM gains is critical, especially for outcome-reward RL Jin et al. (2025b) ; Guo et al. (2025) , where supervision is applied only to the final answer, yet applies generally to any trained search agent for diagnosing failure modes and targeting future training improvements.

blocks.en: Existing evaluation and credit-assignment approaches do not isolate the causal contribution of each functional role under closed-loop execution. Observational behavioral analyses measure surface statistics, such as response length Jin et al. (2025b) ; Guo et al. (2025) , search frequency Jin et al. (2025b) ; Jin et al. (2025a) , or query lexical overlap Jin et al. (2025a) , which correlate with training progress without verifying whether changes in a given role actually increase end-to-end EM accuracy. Single-role ablations Jin et al. (2025a) perturb one component in isolation and therefore miss multi-role interactions where two or more roles must be controlled jointly by the RL policy to produce a gain. Offline trajectory interventions Zheng et al. (2025b) evaluate static prefixes rather than closed-loop execution (interactive feedback with live retrieval), whereas process-reward Lightman et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024b) and step-level credit-assignment methods Gao et al. (2025) alter reward signals during optimization rather than decomposing the learned capabilities of an already-trained checkpoint.

blocks.en: To overcome these limitations, we introduce CO-GRAFT ( Co-Policy Grafting ), a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of the four roles within the same trajectory (Figure 1 b), generating the token spans for its assigned roles and passing the resulting prefix to the other policy at role boundaries. Evaluating all 2 4 = 16 2^{4}=16 role combinations defines Shapley Shapley (1953) values without modifying model weights, requiring access to training rewards, or retraining. From these 16 measurements, Möbius interaction terms Harsanyi (1963) separate standalone single-role improvement from pairwise and higher-order (multi-role) dependencies, and Shapley values aggregate each role’s marginal contribution across all role combinations into a single additive attribution score.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些限制,我们引入了CO-GRAFT(共同政策提取),这是一个奖励-不可知的干预归属框架,在该框架中,经过RL训练的代理人及其RL前初始化联合产生一个具有现场检索功能的单一轨道。 每项政策都控制着同一轨迹内四个角色的相互排斥的子集(图1b),为其分配的角色产生符号跨度,并在角色界限上将由此产生的前缀传给其他政策。 评价所有2 4 = 16 2 = 4 = 16 角色组合定义了 Shapley Shapley (1953) 的值而不修改模型权重,要求获得培训奖励,或再培训. 从这16个测量结果中,Möbius交互术语Harsanyi(1963年)将单作用独立改进与对称和更高顺序(多作用)的依赖性区分开来,Shapley值将每个角色在所有角色组合中的边际贡献汇总成一个单一的添加剂归属分数.

blocks.en: Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents Jin et al. (2025b) ; Jin et al. (2025a) across Qwen2.5 Qwen et al. (2025) and Llama-3.2 Grattafiori et al. (2024) models (spanning two model sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, and GRPO Shao et al. (2024) and PPO Schulman et al. (2017) optimizers on NQ Kwiatkowski et al. (2019) and HotpotQA Yang et al. (2018) datasets) reveals how RL redistributes capability across roles. First, search query generation ( Q ) never accounts for more than 15% of the total RL gain on either dataset, showing that improved retrieval queries are not the primary driver of accuracy gains. Second, pre-RL answer validity, search retention, and model scale govern how credit is distributed between reasoning and answer extraction: larger models and instruction-tuned checkpoints that already produce well-formed answers before RL shift credit from reasoning ( R ) toward final answer extraction ( A ), whereas smaller base models exhibit strong positive coupling between reasoning and decision ( R × \times D ). Third, decision ( D ) gains reflect learning a fixed task-level search budget rather than deciding when to stop based on question-level evidence sufficiency.

blocks.en: We summarize our contributions as follows: • We propose CO-GRAFT , an interventional attribution framework that segments a search agent trajectory into four functional roles ( R , D , Q , and A ) and evaluates all 2 4 = 16 2^{4}=16 role-assignment combinations between an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization under live retrieval without modifying weights or retraining. • We formulate an exact decomposition of RL total EM gains via Shapley values and Möbius interaction terms, isolating standalone role improvements from pairwise and higher-order interactions. • We evaluate Search-R1 agents using our framework across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models on NQ and HotpotQA, showing that RL gains are driven by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets while query generation remains bounded at ≤ 15 % \leq 15\% of total gain.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献总结如下: 我们提出CO-GRAFT这一干预性归属框架,将搜索代理轨迹分为四个功能性角色(R、D、Q和A),并评价所有2 4 = 16 2 = 4 = 16 角色分配组合,一个经过RL训练的代理及其在实时检索下进行RL前初始化,而不修改重量或再培训。 我们通过Shapley值和Möbius相互作用术语对RL总EM增益进行精确的分解,将独立作用改进从对偶和更高顺序的相互作用中分离出来。 我们在NQ和HotpotQA上使用我们跨Quen2.5和Llama-3.2模型的框架来评估搜索-R1代理,显示RL增益是由RL前答有效性,搜索保留,模型尺度,以及固定的任务级搜索预算驱动的,而查询生成仍然被限定在总增益的 15%\leq 15}。

blocks.en: 2 CO-GRAFT
blocks.zh: 2个CO-GRAFT

blocks.en: We introduce CO-GRAFT , an attribution framework that decomposes the performance gain of an RL-trained search agent across the functional roles of its trajectory. To isolate where RL improvements originate, we first partition every trajectory into four exhaustive, non-overlapping roles. We then construct grafted rollouts in which the RL policy and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate trajectories under controlled role assignments, and finally quantify both standalone and synergistic contributions using Shapley decomposition and Möbius interaction terms.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了CO-GRAFT,这是一个归属框架,它分解了一个经过RL训练的搜索代理在其轨迹的功能作用上的性能收益. 为了分离RL改进起源地,我们首先将每个轨迹划分为四个详尽,非重叠的角色. 然后,我们构建了移植的推广,其中RL政策及其前RL初始化在受控角色任务下共同产生轨迹,最后使用Shapley分解和Möbius交互术语量化独立和协同的贡献.

blocks.en: CO-GRAFT decomposes a search-agent trajectory into four distinct roles covering every policy-generated token. Following the standard Search-R1 trajectory format Jin et al. (2025b) , an agent interleaves reasoning blocks ( <think> r \,r\, </think> ) with search calls ( <search> q \,q\, </search> )—each followed by environment-returned passages enclosed in <information> … </information> tags—before terminating with a final response ( <answer> a \,a\, </answer> ; Figure 1 a). We formalize four functional roles , N = { R , D , Q , A } N=\{\textsf{R},\textsf{D},\textsf{Q},\textsf{A}\} : R encompasses all reasoning tokens generated prior to the next action tag; D governs the discrete action selection ( <search> , <answer> , or an incomplete-turn termination); Q comprises the search query string; and A contains the final answer text. Because <information> blocks are injected externally by the retriever rather than sampled from either policy model, they belong to no player. Crucially, this partition assigns every model-generated token in the trajectory to exactly one role, ensuring that any shift in task accuracy traces directly to the specific roles whose output tokens change.
blocks.zh: CO-GRAFT将搜索代理轨迹分解为四个不同的角色,涵盖每个政策产生的信号。 遵循标准的Search-R1轨迹格式Jin et al. (2025b),一个代理程序会与搜索呼叫( < search > q \,q\, </search > )连接的推理区块( < since > r \,r\, </think > ),然后是环境返回的段落,贴在 < information > . </ince > 标记中——最后答复( < sanswer > a\,a\, </answer > ;图1a)。 我们正式确定四个功能角色, N = {R, D, Q, A } N = textsf{R},\ textsf{D},\ textsf},\ textsf{Q},\ textsf{A}: R 包含在下一个动作标记之前生成的所有推理符; D 规范离散动作选择( < search > , < answer > , 或不完整的回合终止); Q 包含搜索查询字符串; A 包含最后的答案文本. 由于 < information> 块是由检索器外部注入的,而不是从任何一种政策模型中取样,所以它们不属于任何玩家。 关键是,这个分区将轨迹中每个模型生成的符号都指定为完全一个角色,确保任务精度的任何变化都直接追溯到输出符号变化的具体角色.

blocks.en: A grafted rollout is a trajectory generated jointly by the RL agent and its pre-RL model, each owning a non-overlapping subset of the roles (Figure 1 b). Let π + \pi^{+} denote the RL-trained agent (the donor ) and π − \pi^{-} denote its exact pre-RL initialization (the recipient ), both sharing the same tokenizer and prompt template. For a grafted policy S ⊆ N S\subseteq N , every role segment ρ \rho is generated by π + \pi^{+} if ρ ∈ S \rho\in S and by π − \pi^{-} otherwise. During generation, whichever policy writes the active segment conditions on the full preceding prefix, including tokens produced by the paired model and live passages returned by the retriever for each search query. To prevent artifacts during policy hand-offs, our harness enforces three invariance constraints: (1) because a model generates reasoning and its subsequent action tag in one pass, the harness discards the tag produced by the owner of R and lets the owner of D decode the action tag from the identical prefix; (2) all hand-offs occur strictly at whole-token boundaries so split tokens (e.g., “ ␣< ” in “ <search> ”) do not distort downstream tokenization; and (3) the harness parses an action only when a complete opening-and-closing tag pair is generated, treating malformed or unclosed tags as invalid turns that pass an error prompt to the next step. All remaining execution mechanics follow the standard search-agent inference loop, recovering pure recipient behavior at S = ∅ S=\emptyset and pure donor behavior at S = N S=N .

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: In this section, we detail our search agents, datasets, metrics, training recipe, retrieval setup, trajectory harness, and auxiliary control tests to study the RL performance gain attribution across agent roles using our proposed CO-GRAFT framework. We examine the publicly available Search-R1 Jin et al. (2025b) ; Jin et al. (2025a) checkpoints, and supplement them by training additional models using the same Search-R1 training and evaluation setting.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们详细介绍了我们的搜索代理、数据集、度量衡、培训食谱、检索设置、轨迹利用和辅助控制测试,以便利用我们提议的CO-GRAFT框架研究RL性能在各代理角色之间的归属。 我们审查公开的Search-R1 Jin等人(2025b)和Jin等人(2025a)检查站,并通过使用同样的Search-R1培训和评估环境培训其他模式来补充这些检查站。

blocks.en: 3.1 Agents
blocks.zh: 3.1 代理人

blocks.en: We choose search agents across two families × \times two starting points × \times two sizes. The first family comprises Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B, each as base and instruct Qwen et al. (2025) . The second comprises Llama-3.2-1B and Llama-3.2-3B, each as base and instruct Grattafiori et al. (2024) . Every recipient is run under its donor’s training prompt, so v ⁡ ( ∅ ) v(\emptyset) is the prompted pre-RL model that prior work reports as the baseline Jin et al. (2025b) .
blocks.zh: 我们选择两个家庭的搜索代理 \ times两个起点 \ times两个大小。 第一个家庭由Quen2.5-3B和Quen2.5-7B组成,各自作为基地并指导Quen等人(2025年)。 第二类包括Llama-32-1B和Llama-32-3B,分别作为基地并指示Grattafiori等人(2024年)。 每位受援者都接受捐赠者的培训,

blocks.en: For each corresponding recipient model above, we obtain an RL-trained (GRPO) donor agent. For Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.2-3B (base and instruct) the donors are available publicly. For Llama-3.2-1B (base and instruct), we train the donors ourselves by following the same recipe (§ 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 对于上述每个相应的受援者模式,我们获得一个经过RL培训的捐助方代理。 对于Qun2.5-3B、Qun2.5-7B和Llama-3.2-3B(基准和指示),捐助者可公开获得。 就Llama-3.2-1B(基地和指示)而言,我们自己按照同样的方法(第3.3节)培训捐助者。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Datasets and Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价数据集和计量

blocks.en:
We use the same evaluation datasets from the Search-R1 setting.
Because running every question through 16 role assignments is computationally expensive, we evaluate on fixed random subsets rather than full test sets: 1,000 questions each of NQ Kwiatkowski et al. (2019) and HotpotQA Yang et al. (2018) .
Our primary metric is EM on the last answer block, and we also report the valid-answer rate (the fraction of questions with a well-formed answer block).
blocks.zh:
我们使用相同的来自Search-R1设置的评价数据集.
因为通过16个角色分配来运行每个问题在计算上都是昂贵的,所以我们评价的是固定的随机子集而不是完整的测试集:NQ Kwiatkowski等人(2019年)和HotpotQA Yang等人(2018年)各1000个问题.
我们的首要衡量标准是最后一个答案块上的EM,我们也报告有效答案率(问题中包含一个完善的答案块的一小部分).

blocks.en: 3.3 Training Recipe
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训工具

blocks.en: We adapt the Search-R1 GRPO recipe to train search agents, including outcome EM reward on the final answer plus a 0.2 format bonus for a well-formed trajectory, retrieved tokens masked from the loss, four search turns of at most 500 generated tokens per turn, group size 5, learning rate 10 − 6 10^{-6} , batch size 512, KL coefficient 10 − 3 10^{-3} , and 1 k k steps of 240 prompts. Moreover, we train on the combined training split of NQ and HotpotQA and evaluate separately on both test sets.
blocks.zh: 我们改编了Search-R1 GRPO的食谱来训练搜索代理,包括最终答案上的结果EM奖励加上0.2格式的奖金,用于一个造型良好的轨迹,从损失中找回了代币,四个搜索转折,每个转折最多500个生成代币,5组大小,学习率10−6 10−6},批量大小512,KL系数10−3 10−3⁄3},以及1 k k 步240 速。 此外,我们还对NQ和HotpotQA的合并培训进行培训,并对两个测试组分别进行评估。

blocks.en: 3.4 Retrieval Environment
blocks.zh: 3.4 检索环境

blocks.en: Following the Search-R1 setup Jin et al. (2025b) , we use E5-base-v2 Wang et al. (2024a) as the dense dual-encoder over the 21M-passage 2018 Wikipedia dump with exact inner-product search. The retriever is queried live during every rollout, returning the top three passages as retrieved evidence.
blocks.zh: 在Search-R1设置Jin et al.(2025b)之后,我们使用E5-base-v2 Wang et al.(2024a)作为2018年维基百科垃圾箱21M通道上的密集双编码器,精确地进行内产搜索. 在每次推出时都会现场询问检索者,将前三段作为检索的证据退回。

blocks.en: 3.5 Harness
blocks.zh: 3.5 调和

blocks.en: To execute multi-turn rollouts, each trajectory in both training and evaluation is bounded to at most four search turns followed by one final answer turn, with a maximum of 500 generated tokens per turn. Any turn that terminates without a complete action tag receives an invalid-action prompt and passes to the next turn if the turn budget permits.
blocks.zh: 为了执行多回合的推出,训练和评价中的每个轨道最多只能有四个搜索转弯,然后是最后一个答录转弯,每个转弯最多可产生500个令牌。 没有完整的动作标记而终止的任何转弯都会得到无效动作的提示,并在转弯预算允许时转弯到下一转弯.

blocks.en: Because trajectory grafting modifies rollout execution flow, we verify that the CO-GRAFT harness preserves single-policy behavior when no role switching occurs, by evaluating S = ∅ S=\emptyset (pre-RL agent only) and S = N S=N (RL agent only), under the original Search-R1 codebase and the CO-GRAFT harness across identical evaluation sets. Across 32 comparisons (8 model pairs, two datasets, and two policy behaviors), CO-GRAFT matches Search-R1 accuracy within single-point EM noise in 28 cases, with the remaining four cases differing by at most 2.3 points. Thus, the harness reproduces baseline policy behaviors without introducing implementation artifacts.
blocks.zh: 由于轨迹牵引改变推出执行流程,我们通过评价S = ∅ S → S emploctyset(仅限RL前代理)和S = N S = N(仅限RL代理),在原Search-R1代码库和CO-GRAFT控制下,在没有进行角色切换时,验证CO-GRAFT控制保留单一政策行为. 在32个比较中(8个模型对、2个数据集和2个政策行为),CO-GRAFT在28个案例中与单点EM噪声中的Search-R1精确度相符,其余4个案例在最多2.3点时有所不同。 因此,这种手段复制了基线政策行为,而没有引进执行文物。

blocks.en: 3.6 Control Experiments
blocks.zh: 3.6 控制实验

blocks.en: We run three control experiments to isolate role attributions from formatting artifacts, fixed search budgets, and query-text conditioning.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了三次控制实验, 将角色属性从 格式化的文物, 固定的搜索预算, 和查询文本的配置中分离出来。

blocks.en: To separate tag compliance from factual gains under strict EM, we recompute attributions using lenient metrics (substring match, token F1, and valid-answer rate). Under lenient scoring on NQ, A attribution collapses for Qwen2.5 models (e.g., from 38% to − 5 -5 % on Qwen2.5-7B base) but persists for Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct (12 vs. 16 EM points), showing that A gains reflect format compliance in Qwen2.5 and content improvement in Llama-3.2. However, Table 1 reports strict EM.
blocks.zh: 为了将遵守与严格EM下的事实收益区分开来,我们用宽松的衡量标准(根据匹配度、符号F1和有效回答率)重新计算归属。 在对NQ的宽大评分下,Quen2.5型号的归属崩溃(例如,在Quen2.5-7B基数上从38%到-5-5%),但对Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct(12对16EM积分)则持续存在,表明A收益反映了Quen2.5格式的遵守和Llama-3.2内容的改进. 然而,表1报告了严格的EM。

blocks.en: To test whether D learns per-question adaptive stopping or a uniform search count, we replace D with a fixed budget B ∈ { 0 , … , 4 } B\in\{0,\dots,4\} while retaining the RL agent’s remaining roles. Across all evaluated pairs, the optimal fixed budget matches the full RL agent within one EM point (e.g., B = 1 B=1 on NQ and B = 2 B=2 on HotpotQA for Qwen2.5-3B PPO), indicating a learned task-level search depth rather than adaptive stopping.
blocks.zh: 为了测试D是否学习每个问题适应性停止或统一搜索计数,我们用固定预算B {{0, }取代D, 4}B\in\0,\dots,4}但保留RL代理的剩余角色。 在所有被评价的对子中,最佳的固定预算匹配一个EM点内的全RL代理(例如,在NQ上B=1B=1,在Quen2.5-3B PPO上B=2B=2HotpotQA),表示学习到的任务级搜索深度而不是适应性停止.

blocks.en: To separate retrieval quality from query-text conditioning, we hold the RL agent’s retrieved passages fixed across all 16 combinations on Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B (PPO). Freezing passages drops Q attribution by 60–100% (0.6–2.5 EM points), confirming that Q gains come from retrieval rather than text conditioning. However, providing RL-retrieved passages to the pre-RL model adds at most 3 EM points, whereas giving the RL agent control of R yields 11–22 EM points under both live and frozen retrieval.
blocks.zh: 为了将检索质量与查询-文本条件区分开来,我们将RL代理的检索通道固定在Quen2.5-3B和Quen2.5-7B(PPO)上,跨越所有16个组合. 冻结通道将Q归属降低60–100%(0.6–2.5 EM积分),证实Q收益来自检索而不是文本条件. 然而,提供RL-检索前的RL模型的段落在最多3 EM点时会增加,而赋予RL代理控制在直播和冷冻检索下输出11–22 EM点.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: In this section, we present our main results in Table 1 and understand the findings across multiple factors, including question complexity, model scale, and instruction tuning.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们在表1中介绍我们的主要结果,并理解包括问题复杂性、模型规模和指令调整在内的多种因素的调查结果。

blocks.en: 4.1 Effect of Question Complexity: Single-hop vs. Multi-hop
blocks.zh: 4.1 问题复杂程度的效果:单跳对多跳

blocks.en: Question complexity has only a secondary effect on role distribution, mainly shifting credit between Reasoning and Answer while overall patterns remain driven by search behavior. Comparing role attributions across single-hop NQ and multi-hop HotpotQA for seven models (two models are excluded because their RL gain fell below the reporting threshold), we find that the Query role remains invariant across task types and stays bounded at or below 15%. In contrast, Reasoning and Answer exhibit a clear trade-off: Reasoning attribution is consistently higher on multi-hop HotpotQA (across six of seven models with maximum up to 33 percentage points), whereas Answer attribution is higher on single-hop NQ (across six of seven models with maximum up to 29 percentage points), reflecting how multi-hop queries promote and shift credit from final answer generation toward intermediate reasoning steps. Meanwhile, the Decision share remains below 25% when search behavior is stable (reaching non-zero search calls), but increases substantially when models either increase or decrease search calls (reaching up to 38–86% when searches drop to zero). Overall, the distributional shift across question complexity is smaller than the divergence induced by changes in search behavior.
blocks.zh: 问题的复杂性只对角色分配产生次要影响,主要是在理性和回答之间转移信用,而总体模式仍然受搜索行为的驱动. 比较单跳NQ和多跳HotpotQA对7个模型的作用归属(两个模型被排除在外,因为其RL增益低于报告阈值),我们发现查询角色在任务类型上仍然变化无常,并且被限制在15%左右. 与此相对照,理性和答案显然是一种权衡: 多跳热点QA(7种模式中的6种,最高33个百分点)的理性归属一直较高,而单跳NQ(7种模式中的6种,最高29个百分点)的答题归属则较高,反映了多跳查询如何促进和将信用从最后的答题一代转向中间推理步骤. 与此同时,当搜索行为稳定(影响非零搜索呼叫)时,决定份额仍然低于25 % , 但当模型增加或减少搜索呼叫(当搜索降至零时达到38-86% ) 时, 则会大幅增加。 总体而言,问题复杂性之间的分配转移小于搜索行为变化引起的差异。

blocks.en: 4.2 Effect of Model Scale: Smaller vs. Larger Models
blocks.zh: 4.2 模型尺度的效果:较小与较大模型

blocks.en: Model scale shifts which roles receive credit, moving attribution away from Reasoning and Decision toward Answer and Query. Across the three families where both sizes gain at least four points (Qwen2.5 base, Qwen2.5 instruct, and Llama-3.2 base), larger models allocate 17 to 40 percentage points more credit to Answer and Query combined in five of six comparisons. This shift is stronger in Qwen2.5 base, where the 3B model relies heavily on Reasoning (70% vs. 40% on NQ; 81% vs. 45% on HotpotQA) while the 7B model shifts 19 to 21 points more toward Answer; Qwen2.5 instruct mirrors this trade-off on HotpotQA (Reasoning 69% vs. 35%; Answer 15% vs. 45%). Similarly, in Llama-3.2 base, the 1B model abandons search (Query ≤ 1 % \leq 1\% ) whereas the 3B model sustains search calls and attributes 12–15% to Query. Because larger models show higher pre-RL valid-answer rates (e.g., 53% vs. 79% on Qwen2.5 NQ) with the exception of Qwen2.5-Instruct, where rates are equal (97%), the gain attributions generally suggest a scale-driven shift toward Answer and Query.
blocks.zh: 模式规模的转变使角色获得信贷,将归属从理性和决策转向回答和查询。 在两个大小都至少获得四分的三个家庭(Quen2.5基数、Quen2.5基数和Llama-3.2基数)中,较大的模型将17至40个百分点的功劳分配给Answer和Query,在6个比较中的5个。 这种转变在Quen2.5基态中更为强烈,3B模型在极大程度上依赖于Reasoning(在NQ值上为70%对40%;在HotpotQA值上为81%对45%),而7B模型向Answer值转移了19到21分;Quen2.5指令镜像在HotpotQA值上进行这种权衡(Resoning 69%对35%;Answer 15%对45%). 同样,在Llama-3.2基座中,1B模型放弃了搜索(查询~% 1%\leq 1+%),而3B模型维持搜索呼叫,并将12–15%的属性归属于查询. 因为较大的模型显示更高的RL前有效回答率(例如,在Quen2.5 NQ上53%对79%),除了Quen2.5-Instruct外,其比例是相等的(97%),所以收益的归属通常暗示了规模驱动的向Answer和Query的转变.

blocks.en: 4.3 Effect of Instruction Tuning: Base vs. Instruct
blocks.zh: 4.3 指令效果:基础对指令

blocks.en: Instruction tuning does not produce a uniform shift in credit allocation; instead, its effect depends on how post-training alters a model’s valid-answer rate and search trajectory. Across four base–instruct pairs, we find that instruction-tuned models with high valid-answer rates realize smaller RL gains and shift attribution toward Answer, whereas models that abandon search stall the RL gains and break the pattern. Specifically, in the Qwen2.5 family (3B and 7B), instruct variants start 18 to 44 percentage points higher in valid-answer rate than their base counterparts, leaving less format learning for RL and yielding 9.9 to 17.5 points lower overall gains while shifting credit from Reasoning ( − 6 -6 to − 34 -34 percentage points) to Answer ( + 8 +8 to + 22 +22 points on NQ). Conversely, Llama-3.2-1B reverses this trend: both variants begin with low valid-answer rates, yet the instruct model gains 6.1 to 11.2 points more because it preserves search (0.9 to 1.0 vs. 0.2 to 0.0 for base), raising Query attribution by 10 to 12 percentage points. Finally, Llama-3.2-3B instruct illustrates the combined effect of both behaviors—starting at a high valid-answer rate (86% vs. 66% on NQ) while abandoning search entirely (1.4–1.6 to 0.0), resulting in negligible gains ( + 1.3 +1.3 to + 3.2 +3.2 points vs. + 22.4 +22.4 to + 31.6 +31.6 for base). Together, these comparisons demonstrate that pre-RL answer validity and search retention predict role attribution far more reliably than instruction tuning alone.
blocks.zh: 指令调试不能导致信贷分配的统一转变;相反,其效果取决于培训后如何改变模型的有效回答率和搜索轨迹。 我们发现,在四个基础对子中,高有效回答率的指令调整模型实现了较小的RL增益,并将归属转向Answer,而放弃搜索的模型则拖住RL增益,打破模式。 具体地说,在Quen2.5家庭(3B和7B)中,指示变体在有效回答率方面开始比基准对等体高18-44个百分点,使得RL的格式学习较少,总收益降低9.9至17.5个百分点,同时将信用从Reasoning(−6-6至−34-34个百分点)转移到Answer(+8+8至+22+22分). 相反,Llama-3.2-1 B扭转了这一趋势:两种变体都以低有效回答率为起点,然而指示模型增益6.1至11.2分,因为它保留了搜索(0.9至1.0对0.2至0.0的基数),将查询归属提高10至12个百分点. 最后,Llama-3.2-3B指示说明了两种行为的综合影响——在完全放弃搜索(1.4-1.6至0.0)的同时,以高有效回答率(86%对66%)开始,结果收益微不足道(+1.3+1.3至+3.2+3.2点对+22.4+22.4至+31.6+31.6)。 这些比较加在一起表明,RL前答有效性和搜索保留可以预测角色归属,远比单调指令更可靠.

blocks.en: 5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 分析

blocks.en: We examine four representative Search-R1 checkpoints in depth to uncover how roles interact and whether the RL optimizer alters credit attribution. Starting from Qwen2.5-3B base—which exhibits the largest Reasoning share in Table 1 —we select three controlled ablations that each vary a single axis: instruction tuning (Qwen2.5-3B instruct), model scale within the same family (Qwen2.5-7B base), and model family at comparable scale (Llama-3.2-3B base). Because public GRPO and PPO checkpoints exist for all four models, this unified selection supports both our role-interaction and optimizer-sensitivity analyses below.
blocks.zh: 我们深入审查四个有代表性的Search-R1检查站,以发现角色如何互动以及RL优化器是否改变信用归属。 从Quen2.5-3B基部开始——该基部在表1中显示出最大的理性份额——我们选择了三个各有不同单一轴的受控卷轴:指令调音(Quen2.5-3B指示),同一家族内的模型尺度(Quen2.5-7B基础),以及可比尺度的模型家族(Llama-3.2-3B基础). 由于所有四种模式都设有公共GRPO和PPO检查站,因此这一统一选择既支持我们的角色互动,也支持下面的优化敏感性分析。

blocks.en: 5.1 Role Interactions: Pairwise and Higher-Order Terms
blocks.zh: 5.1 角色互动:对等和更高顺序术语

blocks.en: While Shapley values quantify how much credit each role receives, Möbius interaction terms (Eq. 2 ; Table 2 ) reveal whether those gains arise independently or through multi-role coordination. A pairwise interaction is positive when two roles produce synergistic gains beyond the sum of their individual effects, and negative when they overlap as substitutes. Across our four focal checkpoints and two datasets, pairwise terms already reshape how Table 1 shares should be read: in Llama-3.2-3B base, R × \times D is the largest pairwise term on both NQ ( + 8.8 +8.8 ) and HotpotQA ( + 5.4 +5.4 ) while solo Reasoning ( + 0.1 +0.1 and − 0.2 -0.2 ) and Decision ( − 2.5 -2.5 and − 0.5 -0.5 ) contribute little or nothing on their own, showing that both roles must act together to improve exact match. Conversely, in Qwen2.5-3B instruct on NQ, negative pairwise terms with Answer ( R × \times A − 8.9 -8.9 , D × \times A − 7.3 -7.3 ) alongside strong solo contributions ( + 11.0 +11.0 for Reasoning, + 6.2 +6.2 for Decision, and + 13.8 +13.8 for Answer against a 19.5 19.5 total gain) indicate redundant overlap rather than joint synergy, while Qwen2.5-7B base shows task sensitivity (single-hop vs. multi-hop) as R × \times A shifts from + 0.9 +0.9 on NQ to + 7.8 +7.8 on HotpotQA.
blocks.zh: 虽然Shapley值量化了每个角色获得的信用,但Möbius互动术语(Eq. 2;表2)显示这些收益是独立产生的,还是通过多作用协调产生的。 当两个角色产生的协同收益超出各自效应的总和时,双向相互作用是积极的,而当它们作为替代物重叠时,相互作用是消极的。 在我们的四个重点检查站和两个数据集中,双向术语已经重塑了表1的股份应如何读取:在Llama-3.2-3B基数中,R ×\time D是NQ(+8.8+8.8)和HotpotQA(+5.4+5.4)中最大的双向术语,而单向理性(+0.1+0.1和−0.2-0.2)和决定(−2.5-2.5和−0.5-0.5)中,两者必须共同发挥作用才能改善准确匹配。 反之,在Qwen2.5-3B指令中,带回答的负对称词(R × times A − 8.9 - 8.9,D × times A − 7.3 - 7.3)与强烈的独奏贡献(说明理由+11.0,决定+6.2 + 6.2,决定+13.8)并列. 对照19.5 19.5总收益)的回答表示冗余重叠而非联合协同,而Quen2.5-7B基础显示任务敏感性(单跳对多跳)为R×\time A从NQ上的+0.9+0.9到热点QA上的+7.8+7.8.

Higher-order Möbius terms further clarify multi-role dynamics, provided that they are interpreted alongside lower-order effects rather than in isolation. Because a three- or four-way term isolates what remains after subtracting lower-order terms, a positive higher-order value can offset negative pairwise interactions rather than prove simultaneous synergy across all included roles as seen on NQ for R × \times D × \times A in Qwen2.5-3B base ( + 5.2 +5.2 offsetting R × \times A − 2.2 -2.2 and D × \times A − 2.9 -2.9 ) and Qwen2.5-3B instruct ( + 7.7 +7.7 offsetting − 8.9 -8.9 and − 7.3 -7.3 ).
By contrast, Llama-3.2-3B base exhibits a positive R × \times D × \times Q term ( + 7.0 +7.0 on NQ) alongside modest or non-negative pairwise terms ( R × \times D + 8.8 +8.8 , R × \times Q + 0.4 +0.4 , D × \times Q − 2.4 -2.4 ), indicating that RL Query adds incremental value once Reasoning and Decision are jointly engaged. Together, Shapley values identify where credit lands, while Möbius terms show whether a share reflects standalone competence (Qwen2.5-3B base), coupled co-adaptation (Llama-3.2-3B base), or overlapping roles (Qwen2.5-3B instruct). This analysis can guide iterative RL training by indicating whether reward shaping should target individual roles or joint role combinations.

blocks.en: The choice of RL optimizer alters the leading role only when it pushes search behavior to the turn limit; otherwise, the starting checkpoint governs which roles capture the performance gain. Comparing public GRPO and PPO checkpoints across four models (Table 3 ), we find that the dominant roles remain consistent under both optimizers for three architectures: Reasoning leads in Qwen2.5-3B base (70% under GRPO vs. 83% under PPO on NQ); Qwen2.5-3B instruct favors Answer on NQ (39% vs. 46%) and Reasoning on HotpotQA (69% vs. 84%); and Llama-3.2-3B base balances Reasoning and Answer within six points on NQ (33% and 34% under GRPO vs. 38% and 32% under PPO) while favoring Answer on HotpotQA (40% vs. 37%). Notably, this invariance holds even when PPO increases search frequency over GRPO in both Qwen2.5-3B variants (2.1 vs. 1.1 and 1.9 vs. 1.3 searches per question on NQ), indicating that moderate shifts in search depth do not reorganize role attribution. The sole exception is Qwen2.5-7B base, where PPO saturates the four-search turn limit on NQ, shifting 77% of credit to Decision and yielding a negative standalone Reasoning share ( − 27 -27 %), whereas GRPO averages 1.1 searches and splits credit evenly between Reasoning (40%) and Answer (38%). Overall, the starting model rather than the RL optimizer establishes the role distribution, with the optimizer disrupting it only when driving search depth to the turn boundary.
blocks.zh: RL优化器的选择只有在将搜索行为推向转弯限制时才会改变主导角色;否则,启动的检查点会支配哪些角色能捕捉性能收益. 对比四个模式的公共GRPO和PPO检查站(表3),我们发现,在三个架构的优化器下,主导作用仍然一致: Qwen2.5-3B基数(GRPO下70%与PPO下83%)和QWen2.5-3B指示优先回答NQ(39%对46%)和HotpotQA(69%对84%)和Llama-3.2-3B基数平衡(GRPO下33%和34%对38%和PPO下32%)在NQ6点内进行解释和回答,同时对HotpotQA(40%对37%)。 值得注意的是,即使PPO在Quen2.5-3B两个变体(2.1对1.1和1.9对1.3对NQ的查询)中都比GRPO增加了搜索频率,这种偏差仍然维持不变,表明搜索深度的中度转变不会重组角色归属. 唯一的例外是Quen2.5-7B基数,PPO在NQ上饱和了四搜索的极限,将77%的信用转移到决策,并产生负的单独理性份额(-27-27%),而GRPO平均搜索1.1,在理性(40%)和回答(38%)之间平分信用. 总体来说,起步模式而不是RL优化器建立了角色分布,优化器只在驱动搜索深度到转弯边界时才会中断.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior work on RL for search agents primarily evaluates end-to-end task performance rather than decomposing which behavioral changes produce the gain. Existing RL search agents Jin et al. (2025b) ; Jin et al. (2025a) ; Song et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2025) ; Zheng et al. (2025b) ; Sun et al. (2025) ; Gao et al. (2025) optimize outcome-based rewards and report aggregate Exact Match (EM) scores. Methods that restrict optimization to query generation Jiang et al. (2025) or assign separate rewards to search and answer steps Wang et al. (2025) pre-specify which trajectory roles require improvement rather than measuring their empirical contributions, while ablations on training configurations Xu et al. (2026) vary algorithmic hyperparameters rather than functional roles. Furthermore, intra-policy credit-assignment methods, including step-level rewards Zheng et al. (2025a) ; Wang et al. (2026) , turn deletion Zhu et al. (2026) , counterfactual branching Li et al. (2026a) , document replay Mukhopadhyay et al. (2026) , and per-role advantage estimation Wu et al. (2026) , compute signals exclusively within a single policy without comparing the trained agent against its pre-RL initialization. CO-GRAFT directly measures the performance difference between the trained policy and its initialization across functional roles.

CO-GRAFT直接衡量训练有素的政策与其在各种职能中初始化之间的绩效差异。

blocks.en: A second line of research combines multiple models during inference or localizes post-training behavioral changes. Venhoff et al. (2026) and Choi et al. (2026) switch between base and post-trained checkpoints at the individual token level during closed-book generation, whereas CO-GRAFT assigns complete functional roles across multi-turn trajectories with live retriever feedback to obtain an exact Shapley attribution of the RL gain. To localize RL improvements, Li et al. (2026b) attribute gains to parameter subsets in weight space, whereas Lyu (2026) demonstrate that out-of-domain gains from math RL with verifiable rewards stem largely from answer formatting, a pattern consistent with our Qwen2.5 findings. Finally, ShapleyFlow Yang et al. (2026) applies Shapley values to static modules within a fixed agentic workflow, whereas CO-GRAFT attributes the training gain between two policies across functional trajectory roles during interactive retrieval.

(2026) 在封闭式图书生成过程中,在基地一级和经过训练后的检查站之间切换,而CO-GRAFT则在多回合轨道上分配完整的功能角色,并有现场检索器反馈,以获得RL收益的确切的Shapley归属. 为了本地化RL改进,Li等人(2026年b)将增益归属于体重空间中的参数子集,而Lyu(2026年)则表明,数学RL带来的可核查回报的域外增益主要来自答案格式化,这个模式符合我们的Quen2.5结论. 最后,夏普利芙蓉杨等. (2026年)将Shapley值应用于固定代理工作流程中的静态模块,而CO-GRAFT则将交互检索过程中跨越功能轨迹角色的两个政策之间的培训收益归为属性.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduce CO-GRAFT , a framework that decomposes the EM gain of an RL-trained search agent across its four trajectory roles under closed-loop execution, showing that pre-RL answer validity, search retention, and model scale govern whether gains stem from reasoning–decision coupling, fixed task-level search budgets, or final answer extraction, while search query generation ( Q ) never exceeds 15% of the total gain on NQ and HotpotQA. Because outcome-based EM obscures which functional behavior improves during training, future RL reward designs targeting retrieval skill should explicitly supervise query formulation ( Q ) and evidence-sufficient stopping decisions ( D ).
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 CO-GRAFT , 这个框架将 RL 训练的搜索代理器的EM 收益分解在闭路执行下的四个轨迹作用上, 显示 RL 预答有效性, 搜索保留, 以及模型规模 是否来自推理 — 决策耦合, 固定任务级搜索预算, 或最终解答提取, 而搜索查询生成(Q) 从未超过 NQ 和 HotpotQA 总收益的 15% 。 由于基于结果的EM模糊了培训期间哪些功能行为有所改进,未来的RL奖励针对检索技能的设计应当明确监督查询的制定(Q)和证据充足的停止决定(D).

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: CO-GRAFT attributes the performance difference between a pair of policies rather than evaluating a standalone checkpoint, and its interpretations are subject to the properties of cooperative game-theoretic decomposition and our experimental setup. Attribution shares measure gains relative to a chosen baseline policy (the pre-RL initialization), and Shapley values average marginal contributions across all role permutations; when multi-role interactions are substantial (such as in the Qwen2.5-7B PPO pair), additive Shapley shares alone do not capture joint dependencies and must be interpreted alongside the Möbius interaction terms. In addition, functional boundaries are segmented using structural action tags, grouping internal planning, passage synthesis, and structural formatting together inside the intermediate reasoning role ( R ), leaving finer-grained decompositions of R to future work.
blocks.zh: CO-GRAFT将一对政策之间的性能差异归属于一对政策,而不是评价一个独立的检查站,其解释取决于合作游戏理论分解和我们的实验设置的属性. 分配股份衡量相对于所选择的基准政策(RL初始化前)的增益,而Shapley值在所有角色表层的平均边际贡献;当多作用相互作用是实质性的(如在Quen2.5-7B PPO配对中)时,仅添加的Shapley股份并不能捕捉到联合依赖,必须和Möbius交互术语一起解释. 此外,功能边界使用结构动作标记进行分解,将内部规划,通道合成,结构格式在中间推理角色(R )内组合在一起,将R的细纹分解留待未来工作.

blocks.en: Our empirical evaluation is also bounded by model scale, inference serving stochasticity, and diagnostic scope. Compute constraints limit our locally trained models to 7B parameters or smaller, requiring us to omit a 14B or 32B model pair, and batched greedy decoding introduces approximately one EM point of serving variance. Furthermore, the fixed-budget and retrieval-swap diagnostics cover only the two Qwen2.5 PPO pairs on NQ and HotpotQA, and selecting the optimal budget on the evaluation set provides an upper-bound estimate within this noise floor. Finally, training recipes incorporating query-level process rewards, longer optimization schedules, or live web search may redistribute gains differently across roles, which CO-GRAFT can be directly applied to measure.
blocks.zh: 我们的经验评价还以模型尺度、用于分析的推论和诊断范围为界。 计算限制将我们本地训练的模型限制在7B参数或更小,要求我们省略14B或32B模型对,分批的贪婪解码引入了大约一个EM点的服务差异. 此外,固定预算和检索-扫描诊断只涵盖NQ和HotpotQA上的两对Quen2.5 PPO对,在评价组上选择最佳预算,在这一噪音层内提供上限估计。 最后,包含查询级流程奖励、较长优化时间表或现场网络搜索等内容的培训方法可能以不同方式重新分配不同角色的收益,CO-GRAFT可直接用于衡量。

(4) For intermediate reasoning ( R ), ϕ R \phi_{\textsf{R}} equals the standalone term m ⁡ ( { R } ) m(\{\textsf{R}\}) , plus half of the three pairwise terms containing R , one-third of the three three-way terms containing R , and one-quarter of the four-way term.
Thus, Möbius terms identify which roles (individually or jointly) generate performance gains, whereas Shapley values summarize each role’s overall contribution into a single scalar without retaining higher-order coupling structure.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 visualizes the standalone and pairwise Möbius terms from Table 2 across agents and datasets.
Diagonal entries display single-role gains, off-diagonal entries display pairwise interactions, right-hand bars show Shapley values, and H H aggregates the three- and four-role terms omitted from the 2D grid.
Three structural regimes emerge:
(1) For Qwen2.5-3B base, the standalone reasoning diagonal ( + 19 +19 on NQ, + 21 +21 on HotpotQA) dominates all other entries, while every pairwise interaction remains within ± 3 \pm 3 points, confirming largely additive role contributions.
(2) For Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct on NQ, all four diagonal terms are positive ( + 4 +4 to + 14 +14 ) whereas all six pairwise terms are negative ( − 2 -2 to − 9 -9 ), demonstrating substantial cross-role redundancy.
(3) For Llama-3.2-3B base, the standalone diagonals for reasoning and decision are zero or negative ( 0 0 and − 3 -3 on NQ; 0 0 and − 1 -1 on HotpotQA), while R × \times D forms the largest pairwise entry on both datasets ( + 9 +9 and + 5 +5 ), showing strong coupling between reasoning and search termination.
Finally, H H is substantial for Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct ( + 13.8 +13.8 ) and Llama-3.2-3B base ( + 15.3 +15.3 ) on NQ, requiring joint inspection of the matrix alongside the higher-order columns of Table 2 .
blocks.zh:
图2可视化表2的单独和对称的Möbius术语,跨越代理和数据集.
对角条目显示单作用增益,离对角条目显示对偶相互作用,右侧栏显示Shapley值,H汇总2D网格中省略的三和四作用术语.
出现了三种结构制度:
(1)对于Qwen2.5-3B基数,独立推理对角(NQ上+19+19,HotpotQA上+21+21)在所有其他条目中占主导地位,而每对对角交互都保持在±3\pm 3点之内,证实大部分是添加作用贡献.
(2)对于在NQ上的Quen2.5-3B-指令,所有四个对角词都是正数(+4+4到+14+14),而所有六个对角词都是负数(−2−2到−9−9),显示出大量的交叉作用冗余.
(3)对于Llama-3.2-3B基,用于推理和决定的独立对角线为0或负(NQ上的0和−3-3;HotpotQA上的0和−1-1),而R ×\times D则在两个数据集(+9+9和+5+5)上形成最大的对角条目,显示出推理和搜索终止之间的强烈结合.
最后,H对NQ上的Quen2.5-3B-指示(+13.8+13.8)和Llama-3.2-3B基础(+15.3+15.3)具有实质性意义,需要与表2的更高顺序栏一道对矩阵进行联合检查。

blocks.en:
We present qualitative case studies illustrating three distinct attribution patterns: gains driven by intermediate reasoning ( R ), final answer extraction ( A ), and search-or-answer decisions ( D ).
For each case, we select an evaluation instance where the pre-RL initialization fails, the RL-trained agent succeeds, and performance across the 16 role assignments tracks control of the target role.
Figures 3 – 5 display the complete trajectories (with line breaks collapsed and retrieved passage text omitted for readability) with color-coding each generated span by the active role policy.

我们提出定性案例研究,说明三种不同的归属模式:中间推理驱动的收益(R),最后答案提取(A),以及搜索或答案决定(D)。
对于每个案例,我们选择一个评价实例,其中RL前初始化失败,RL训练的代理成功,16个角色任务的表现跟踪目标角色的控制.
图3 – 5 显示完整的轨迹(由于行间断裂,可读性而省略了检索的段落文本),每个路段由积极角色政策生成颜色编码。
